messages.text: “I am very sorry to hear that, and I understand how frustrating it is to lose the Wi-Fi all day. This is the Listen and Apologise part. Let me send our technician to your room right away, and I will switch you to our backup network in the meantime. This is the Act part. As an apology, I would like to offer you a late check-out, and I will check back within the hour to make sure it is working. This is the Follow up part.”
